newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle lower in front months.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle lower in front months.

text.p: FCOJ futures closed barely weaker in thin and rangebound trade.
The market has little fundamental inspiration to break out of its recent trading range, as the 1996/97 Florida harvest is nearly complete.
Spot July orange juice settled 0.10 cent weaker at 75.80 cents per lb, after ranging from 76.50 to 75.40 cents. September ended 0.25 lower, and the rest of the board closed 0.05 to 1.30 higher.
Light trade buying was cited in volume estimated at 3,000 lots. Tuesday's official volume was 2,958 lots.
Technical analysts expect prices to ease further, with support in July pegged at 74.00 cents.
Open interest climbed to 35,735 lots as of Tuesday, from 34,972 lots the previous session.
